model: LogisticRegression (scikit-learn Pipeline), selected by GroupKFold comparison across 2 candidate model families
dataset: UCI Parkinsons Telemonitoring (id=189), Tsanas & Little (2009), https://doi.org/10.24432/C5ZS3N
target_column: worsening (delta_total_UPDRS >= 3.0 from patient's own baseline visit)

target_meaning.1: total_UPDRS increased by >= 3.0 points since the patient's first recorded visit
target_meaning.0: stable or improving relative to baseline

threshold_disclaimer: 3.0 points is an illustrative demonstration threshold chosen for this project, NOT a clinically validated minimal-detectable-change value. Do not present this as a clinically established cutoff.
why_this_framing: Two prior attempts (absolute total_UPDRS regression, and exact delta-from-baseline regression) both failed patient-level GroupKFold validation with negative R^2 across 5 total model fits. This reframes the same features/target as a coarser binary 'trending worse or not' question, evaluated by ROC-AUC (rank-ordering only, not exact magnitude), as a lower and more achievable bar.
evaluation_strategy: GroupKFold cross-validation (10 folds, grouped by patient subject#) across all 42 subjects. Zero patient leakage between train and test in any fold. All predictions pooled before computing metrics.
disclaimer: Trained on a public research dataset for demonstration purposes only. Never trained or evaluated on real patient data. Not used anywhere in the live patient workflow/orchestrator pipeline.
